description: Import tasks from CSV file with validation and parallel creation. CRITICAL: ALWAYS use validate_only=true first! Production safety: validate → fix errors → import.

continue_on_error.description: Continue importing valid rows even if some fail (default: true)

csv_data.description: CSV data as string (use this OR csv_file_path)

csv_file_path.description: Path to CSV file (use this OR csv_data)

dartboard.description: Dartboard dart_id or name for all imported tasks

validate_only.description: Preview mode (default: TRUE for production safety). Returns validation errors and preview without creating tasks.

name: import_tasks_csv
